assessment.hda_alone_passthrough: not possible as configured: VFIO assigns a whole IOMMU group, and group 15 also holds the eSPI (LPC) bridge, the SMBus controller and the SPI flash controller of the PCH (functions of the same multifunction device 00:1f, no ACS isolation). All four would have to leave their host drivers; the eSPI bridge and SPI controller are platform devices of the running host.
assessment.hda_with_igd_same_guest: the IGD is alone in group 0 and is assignable; the HDA is not independently assignable (above), so IGD + HDA in one guest has the same blocker.
ways_out_needing_a_human_decision: pcie_acs_override is not in the Debian kernel and a cmdline/kernel change is outside the approved host operations
assign the whole group 15 (eSPI, SMBus, SPI with HDA): risky for the host (platform/firmware devices)
p008 on QEMU intel-hda only, plus a bare-metal zedBSD boot of the Latitude for the real HDA
a USB audio device passed through with QEMU usb-host (none attached now)
assessment.also_noted: the HDA reports no reset method; even an assignable HDA could not be reset between guest runs by VFIO
